budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chapter 70 is to increase 2.4% and Unrestricted General Government Aid 3.6%, more than anticipated; the 40S payment's continuation is uncertain.
budget_items.quote: chapter 70 will receive an increase of 2.4% and unrestricted general government aid will have a 3.6 % increase

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Health insurance renewal increased 10.9%, against a projected 7%.
budget_items.quote: health insurance renewal has increased 10.9%; she had projected 7%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Monty Tech assessment is not yet known and may be about $48,000 more than the preliminary budget listed.
budget_items.quote: it may possibly be $48,000 more than listed on the preliminary budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total snowstorm costs are around $300,000; the town has the potential to be reimbursed 70% by FEMA; the Governor filed legislation to allow amortizing over two years.
budget_items.quote: the total costs the town incurred during those storms is around $300,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY'16 budget recommendation includes the FY'15 40S payment; the Governor may add a second payment not anticipated. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: it also included the 40s payment which she is not sure if that will stay or not.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Overall Cherry Sheet charges were about what was expected. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the cherry sheet charges overall were about what we were expecting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Payroll deduction, payroll and accounts payable warrants were presented and signed.
budget_items.quote: payroll deduction warrant in the amount of $487,168.37; payroll warrant in the amount of $705,849.91 and the accounts payable warrant of $386,626.77 were presented and signed.
